pages.title: Boxes and rare prizes
pages.text: Use the dedicated box machine: preview, then open.

Default Supply Boxes cost 64 points; Treasure Boxes cost 512. Each tile shows its chance at the top right and a ×N count below. Each box draws one entry.$(br2)Open 1, 10 or 64 at once. Last opening shows the actual results.

Supply: 16 entries, including two diamonds (1.8%) and a netherite ingot (0.2%).$(br2)Treasure includes 16 diamonds (0.5%), an enchanted golden apple (0.5%) and a netherite ingot (1%). Friendly/neutral mob eggs total 10%. Neutral mobs can retaliate.

pages.title: Drawing prizes
pages.text: Prize chances are shown in the pool preview. Each box draws independently; bulk opening does not improve individual odds. There is no pity guarantee.$(br2)Eggs are prize-only and cannot be traded. Valuable outcomes do not guarantee a profit on every box.

Boxes have no default level or advancement gate. Overflow is saved in Pending, even across logouts.$(br2)Free inventory space and click Claim pending or use /teamecon claimboxes. Claiming never rerolls or charges again. Claim the batch before opening more.

pages.title: Potions and custom pools
pages.text: Each default pool has five potion entries, including splash and lingering variants.$(br2)Operators: /teamecon admin boxes opens a prize template grid. Drag or Shift-click inventory items to add samples without consuming them. Select a template to edit quantity and percentage. Chances must total 100% to save. Box settings controls names and prices.
